content.short: Mobile application around the most basic needs of users: smart alerts, real-time information on asset prices, etc...
content.description:
Most Cardano blockchain users use mobile phones, but there are very few apps on the Cardano ecosystem that support users in managing their assets and tracking the Cardano ecosystem. We have identified the following common needs of basic users: Information about native assets in the Cardano ecosystem. Asset portfolio management. Notification of balance changes when a transaction occurs. Information about projects built on Cardano. For this reason, in this concept phase, we propose to create a mobile app that solves most of these needs. Specifically: Information about native assets: The app will provide information about the value of assets, price charts, and basic information about projects built on Cardano. Asset portfolio management: Display the types of assets and asset values in the wallet, and calculate rewards by epoch. Smart alerts: Our app will help users receive notifications about balance changes and price fluctuations of native assets on Cardano. Information about major events: The app will continuously update important information such as ISPOs, testnets, mainnets, presales, and important updates from major projects on the Cardano ecosystem.
